plugins.name: plan
plugins.description: Plan — a planning skill suite. Authors and revises the plan document a task requires before implementation begins: the rules the thing was built inside, the guarantees it makes, requirements, design decisions, blast radius, failure modes, and execution order. Nine skills: a hub, a standalone audit, an investigation, a cascade, and five write atomics.
